Flagship build

The build nobody asked for

I was hired as an executive assistant. I saw a reporting gap, so I built the tool to close it.

The problem

The Sales Performance Coach at the #1 Allstate agency in the US had agent numbers spread across sheets, with no single place to see who was on track and who needed coaching.

What I built

A custom web app: a Google Sheets + Apps Script backend, login, live Chart.js dashboards, KPI and tier-ranking logic, and an agent leaderboard.

The result

Warm transfers, quote rates, close rates, and 60-day trends for every agent in one view, with weekly and monthly reporting that updates itself.

Apps Script Google Sheets Chart.js JavaScript Built with Claude

Designed and coded with AI as my pair programmer. No developer, no agency.
